caption: The drawing depicts a stylized human figure with a halo created from radiating spikes and small circles, featuring colors like blue, yellow, black, red, and gray. The figure has brown hair, a light skin tone, and is dressed in a layered robe with green, red, blue, yellow, and cream-colored patterns arranged in a striped and circular fashion. The arms are positioned in front of the chest, with the hands together as if in prayer. The outer garment is green with a red border, the inner dress alternates between blue, cream, and teal horizontal bands with decorative red, yellow, and white accents. The lower part of the garment and figure stands on a pedestal-like base made up of cylindrical forms in red, blue, and white stripes. There are green leaf-like shapes emerging to the left and right of the pedestal. At the bottom, there is an angular, step-like structure outlined in red, which supports the pedestal and the figure above. The background of the drawing is plain and beige.
title: New Mexico, "Bulto", Polychromed Wooden Figure
